title: Electric Dipole Field Lines
description: Two fixed charges of equal and opposite magnitude creating a classic dipole field. The field lines emerge from the positive charge and terminate on the negative charge.

objects.label: Positive Charge (+q)
objects.education_note: A fixed positive charge. Electric field lines start here.

objects.label: Negative Charge (-q)
objects.education_note: A fixed negative charge. Electric field lines end here.

objects.label: Dipole Field
objects.education_note: The total field is the vector sum of fields from each charge.

controls.label: Charge Separation
controls.education_note: Distance from origin for each charge. Increasing this spreads the field out.

controls.label: Charge Magnitude
controls.education_note: Adjusts the strength of both charges symmetrically.

educational_sequence.title: Observe Field Lines
educational_sequence.instruction: Look at how the lines curve from the red positive charge to the blue negative charge.

educational_sequence.title: Change Separation
educational_sequence.instruction: Move the charges closer together. How does the field line density change between them?
